g.text: Schematic land-use plan of a town (not a measured map)
The CBD (offices, shops, services) sits at the central junction
Housing occupies the west and south; industry lies beside the
eastern freight railway; a shopping strip lines the northern
access road; the park is south-east.
Different functions occupy connected but separate locations. This
is a schematic model, not a measured map of Windhoek, and it
